about: The evangelium of the formulary “Saint Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus saw a man sitting at the tax office, Matthew by name. And He said to him: Follow me. And rising, he followed Him. And it came to pass, as He was sitting at table in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and were sitting at table with Jesus and His disciples. And when the Pharisees saw it, they were saying to His disciples: Why does your Teacher eat with publicans and sinners? But Jesus, hearing it, said: Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are ill. Go, then, and learn what this means: It is mercy I desire, and not sacrifice. For I did not come to call the just, but sinners.
